# Morning Briefing – Night 20

## 🚀 High‑Priority Items (Decide / Act by Week’s End)

| # | Item | Deadline | What to do |
|---|------|----------|------------|
| 1 | **Workshop paper baseline** – Create a naive‑append baseline using MemGPT‑style paging and integrate it into the agent‑memory benchmark framework (56cc7f88). | **Wed 23 NIGHT** | Draft code & evaluation scripts. |
| 2 | **Rewrite‑vs‑append ablation** – Run full-scale experiments (1d798fb7) with periodic consolidation (0cab017c) on the new H100 budget (ca4aab4c) to demonstrate >9 F1 gain. | **Wed 23 NIGHT** | Allocate 1,200 GPU‑hrs for ablation sweep + 1,200 for consolidation+paging tests. |
| 3 | **Respond to ICLR reviewer** – Include audit of benchmark, naive‑append baseline, and ablation results. | **Mon 21 DAY** | Draft rebuttal paragraph + attach readme. |
| 4 | **Outline review** – Maya and d.okafor have awaited feedback on the rough workshop outline. | **Fri 18 DAY** | Draft feedback (≤150 words) & send. |

> **Nudge:**  
> *GPU allocation resets monthly—note budget limits for any new runs > 2400 hrs.*

## 🔍 Status Check  

* **Rebuttal** received; review now in progress.  
* **Append issue**: Token budget exceeded on day 20; QA drops after 40 items (d2609f66).  
* **GPU hours**: 2400 H100‑hrs available.  

## 📌 Hypothesis Highlight  

**Overnight idea:**  
Implementing MemGPT’s virtual‑context paging *plus* periodic consolidation will eliminate the 40‑item QA drop and outperform the rewrite-only baseline, offering a cleaner isolation of the rewrite contribution while staying within token limits.  

### Draft Note  
> Draft: “By integrating MemGPT’s paging with our periodic consolidation schedule, we expect to keep the active context under the token budget and mitigate retrieval interference beyond 40 items.”

No other commitments changed today.
